title: bootc-installer branding
description: Product identity for every installer frontend. Every key is optional; a missing or empty value falls through to os-release, then to a neutral default. See shared/branding/README.md.

name.description: Product name shown to the user, e.g. "Skipjack". Falls back to PRETTY_NAME then NAME.

id.description: Lower-case identifier written as the recipe's distroID. Falls back to ID.

vendor.description: Who makes the product; shown in about dialogs. Falls back to VENDOR_NAME then NAME.

home_url.description: Product website. Falls back to HOME_URL.

docs_url.description: Documentation site. Falls back to DOCUMENTATION_URL.

support_url.description: Support or community site. Falls back to SUPPORT_URL.

logo.description: Themed icon name or absolute path for welcome and done artwork. Falls back to LOGO.

default_hostname.description: Initial hostname. Falls back to DEFAULT_HOSTNAME then ID.

default_image.description: OCI reference installed when the frontend offers no catalog choice and is not on a live ISO. No os-release fallback.
